title: FaultsFile
description:
`faults.yaml`: what most likely went wrong when a step does not give its expected result,
and what to do, for Practice's Faults questions.

Fault.description: The likely causes when a step does not give the expected result.

action.description: What to do about it. Practice asks for it.

causes.description: The likely causes, each a short sentence. Practice asks for one of them.

steps.description:
The steps it is about; each must be a step of the pack. Practice asks about the first
one, when that step has an `if_not`, alongside faults in the same flight deck area.

StepId.description:
A stable step id: `<pack-id>.<phase>.<short-name>`, e.g. `demo-aircraft.preflight.irs-mode`.
An id never changes once published, even if the step is reworded or moved to another phase.
